scheduling.note: Drip cadence is FORTNIGHTLY, not weekly. Valid slots are referenceDate + k*14 days (2026-08-13, 2026-08-27, ...), matching the parity check in .github/workflows/fortnightly-deploy.yml. Next open slot = smallest valid slot strictly after the latest `date` across content/blog (including future-dated queued posts) that is not in the past. A batch of N articles takes N consecutive slots in queue order. Never assign two articles the same date. `npm run blog:queue` prints the queue and the next open slot.

rules: Frontmatter contract: `title` (quoted, under ~65 chars), `description` (~155 chars, meta description), `date` (quoted "YYYY-MM-DD" string), `tags` (array of 3-6 Title Case tags), optional `itemList` + `listTitle` (drives ItemList schema for listicles), optional `faq` (list of {question, answer} pairs — drives FAQPage schema), optional `draft: true` to hold a post out of every build regardless of date.

FAQ lives in frontmatter ONLY; never render an FAQ section in the body. The slug page generates BlogPosting + ItemList + FAQPage JSON-LD from frontmatter automatically — never hand-write schema in the body.
No H1 in the body: the page renders `title` as the H1 and the markdown renderer demotes any body h1 to h2. Start at `##`.

Renderer is react-markdown + remark-gfm + rehype-raw, so inline HTML/CSS works: build the one required chart as div/span HTML with inline styles (dark theme: slate-900 backgrounds, indigo-400/cyan-400 accents), never an image and never inline SVG.

Voice: written by a DM/player who runs real games (author is Christopher Melson). Practical, specific, lightly wry. The product is "Tabletop Time" — mention it where it genuinely solves the problem being discussed, roughly once per major section at most, never as a hard sell.

Tabletop Time is free and requires no login for players; do not invent pricing, tiers, or features. Feature claims must match /features: quorum logic, magic links, no-account voting, Telegram and Discord bots, reminders.

Internal links at write time: 2-3 links to related posts as relative /blog/<slug> (pick from the published list), plus exactly one money-page link where it fits naturally (/features, /how-it-works, /what-is-quorum-scheduling for the concept, /vs/doodle or /vs/when2meet for comparisons).
Audience intent is informational (how to schedule/run tabletop games); do not target commercial comparison keywords already owned by /vs/doodle and /vs/when2meet.

Hero image is an inline markdown image right after the intro paragraph with a *Photo: <author> via <source>* attribution line in italics beneath it, matching existing posts. Use the local file at /images/blog/<slug>.jpg once blog-hero.mjs has produced it.

checks: `date` is a quoted YYYY-MM-DD string falling on a valid fortnightly slot (2026-08-13 + a multiple of 14 days) and is later than every other post's date in content/blog.
No llms.txt step needed: app/llms.txt/route.ts generates the Blog list from getAllPosts() at build time (there is no public/llms.txt; never recreate one).
No body H1, no FAQ section in the body, and the chart is inline div/span HTML (not SVG, not an image).

image.strategy: Run blog-hero.mjs (stock-only). Then reference the image as the inline markdown hero described in the contract rules; there is no heroImage frontmatter field on this site.
